Massive resistance from the people briefly liberated Pabna
2023-03-01T23:06:50+06:00 | Star Special
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-multimedia/news-multimedia/news/massive-resistance-the-people-briefly-liberated-pabna-3260706

In March 1971, facing massive resistance from the people, the Pakistani army was forced to retreat from Pabna. Though that freedom lasted for a few days, the bravery of the people there gave the country the moral boost it needed in its struggle for independence.

Freedom fighter Baby Islam recalls the glorious chapter in our Liberation War.
